description_en: Checks whether a user is authorized to use Key Management Service (KMS)
kebab_example: aliyun polardb check-kms-authorized --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000 --tde-region cn-beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckKMSAuthorized

parameters.help_en:
